formats.fp16_from_w4_codes: the same four-bit codes decoded to FP16 constants; FP16 activations
formats.w4a16: four-bit indices, INT8 palette, per-output-channel FP16 scale; FP16 activations
formats.w8a8_same_codes: the same codes stored as INT8 with the same scale; static per-tensor A8 QDQ at each projection
formats.a8w4_int8_lut: the W4A16 weight representation with the W8A8 activation QDQ

workloads.mlp: down(gelu_tanh(gate(x)) * up(x)), no attention, residual or normalization
workloads.synthetic: the K512 128-layer 1×1 convolution chain over 64×64 positions, Core ML only

n64.matmul: FP16 decoded weights, FP32 GEMM, FP16 output
n64.qdq: exact ratio of FP16 value and scale; nearest ties away, signed int8 saturation
n64.scope: synthetic controls and independently generated RMS-1 benchmark inputs, not text activations

n1024.matmul: FP16 decoded weights, FP32 GEMM, FP16 output
n1024.qdq: exact ratio of FP16 value and scale; nearest ties away, signed int8 saturation
n1024.scope: synthetic controls and independently generated RMS-1 benchmark inputs, not text activations

ordinary_rows: rows 6 onward; rows 0-5 are the boundary controls
order: per round sorted by workload, positions, format and runtime; odd rounds reversed; one new host per block

host.timing: synchronous MLModel.prediction or awaited function.run per call; API start and end clocks

scope: Real E4B weights with seeded RMS-normalized synthetic activations. Per-block wall-clock speed and software component energy; no model quality, attention, KV cache or exclusive per-operation placement.
